description:
On develop 01e69178a 'name :: type' is accepted only on a top-level function parameter. Inside a struct field pattern (%S{funs: fs :: list}), a tuple pattern ({e, fs :: list}), a map pattern (%{funs: fs :: list}), a defimpl function head, and a bare case clause head (x :: list ->) the compile stops with 'internal/post-resolution-leftover: quoted function decode failed: unsupported quoted pattern head `::`', an internal-class error without a source span.
Decision needed: support the annotation in nested patterns (it would let a library state a field's type at the read site, which fz-i89 showed matters because a spec result is not read for an unproven argument), or keep it unsupported and report a spanned parse/type diagnostic.
Fails before, passes after: either fixtures where each nested form tests its value on all three paths, or a diagnostic fixture per form with a span.
Acceptance: full gate green.
title: A type annotation inside a pattern is a spanned diagnostic or is supported
